description: A large group of diseases that can start in almost any organ or tissue of the body when abnormal cells grow uncontrollably.
causes: Genetic mutations, environmental factors (tobacco, radiation), and lifestyle choices.
prevention: Avoid tobacco, maintain a healthy weight, protect skin from sun, and get regular screenings.
treatment_action: Surgery, chemotherapy, radiation therapy, immunotherapy, and targeted therapy.
complications: Spread to other organs (metastasis), pain, and organ failure.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A clouding of the normally clear lens of your eye.
symptoms: Increasing difficulty with vision at night
prevention: Regular eye exams, quit smoking, and wear sunglasses.
treatment_action: Surgery to replace the clouded lens with an artificial one.
complications: Vision loss and blindness if left untreated.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: An immune reaction to eating gluten, a protein found in wheat, barley and rye.
causes: Genetic predisposition and ingestion of gluten.
prevention: No known way to prevent, but managing diet is key.
complications: Malnutrition, bone weakening, infertility, and neurological problems.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A group of disorders that affect movement and muscle tone or posture.
causes: Abnormal brain development or damage to the developing brain.
treatment_action: Physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, and medications.
complications: Muscle contracture, malnutrition, mental health conditions, and lung disease.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A highly contagious viral infection that causes an itchy, blister-like rash on the skin.
treatment_action: Relieving symptoms with calamine lotion, cool baths, and acetaminophen.
complications: Bacterial infections of the skin, pneumonia, and inflammation of the brain (encephalitis).
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A common sexually transmitted infection (STI) caused by bacteria.
prevention: Safe sex practices and regular STI testing.
complications: Pelvic inflammatory disease (PID), infertility, and ectopic pregnancy.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: An acute diarrheal infection caused by ingestion of contaminated food or water.
prevention: Drink safe water, wash hands, and practice good sanitation.
treatment_action: Oral rehydration solution (ORS) and antibiotics in severe cases.
complications: Severe dehydration and death within hours if untreated.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A chronic inflammatory lung disease that causes obstructed airflow from the lungs.
causes: Long-term exposure to irritating gases or particulate matter, most often from cigarette smoke.
prevention: Don't smoke and avoid exposure to air pollutants.
treatment_action: Inhalers, oxygen therapy, and pulmonary rehabilitation.
complications: Respiratory infections, heart problems, lung cancer, and depression.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: Late-stage scarring (fibrosis) of the liver caused by many forms of liver diseases and conditions.
causes: Chronic alcohol abuse, hepatitis, and fatty liver disease.
prevention: Limit alcohol, maintain a healthy weight, and protect against hepatitis.
treatment_action: Treating the underlying cause and managing complications.
complications: Liver failure, liver cancer, and portal hypertension.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A viral infection of your nose and throat.
prevention: Wash hands, avoid touching face, and stay away from sick people.
treatment_action: Rest, fluids, and over-the-counter cold medicines.
complications: Ear infection, asthma attacks, and sinusitis.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: An inflammation or infection of the transparent membrane that lines your eyelid and covers the white part of your eyeball.
symptoms: Redness in one or both eyes
Discharge that forms a crust during the night
prevention: Wash hands often and don't share personal items like towels or eye makeup.
treatment_action: Antibiotic eye drops (for bacterial) or allergy medications.
complications: Inflammation in the cornea that can affect vision.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A type of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) that causes inflammation of your digestive tract.
prevention: No known way to prevent, but managing stress and diet can help.
treatment_action: Anti-inflammatory drugs, immune system suppressors, and surgery.
complications: Bowel obstruction, ulcers, fistulas, and malnutrition.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A condition that occurs from exposure to high cortisol levels for a long time.
causes: Overuse of steroid medications or overproduction of cortisol by the adrenal glands.
prevention: Use steroid medications only as prescribed and at the lowest effective dose.
treatment_action: Reducing steroid use, surgery, radiation, or medications.
complications: Bone loss (osteoporosis), high blood pressure, and type 2 diabetes.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: An inherited disorder that causes severe damage to the lungs, digestive system and other organs.
treatment_action: Medications, chest physical therapy, and pulmonary rehabilitation.
complications: Chronic respiratory failure, diabetes, and liver disease.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: Inflammation of the bladder, usually caused by a urinary tract infection (UTI).
prevention: Drink plenty of water and practice good hygiene.
